stem.text: The diagram shows the structure of the polysaccharide chitin which is found in the cell wall of fungi.

stem.alt: Structural formula of a polysaccharide chain of three linked sugar rings, showing CH2OH groups, ring oxygens, C=O groups, N–H bonds and CH3 groups.

stem.text: Which statements are correct for chitin **and** for cellulose?

items: The monomers are joined by 1,4 glycosidic bonds.
Every second monosaccharide in the polysaccharide chain is rotated by $180^{\circ}$.
The polysaccharide contains the elements carbon, hydrogen, oxygen and nitrogen.
